notes.title: Big Tofas Update
notes.content:
We have added many innovations to keep our game up to date. Here are some new systems we added;
[list]
[*] Added 6 New Cars
[*] Added Chat System
[*] Added Voice Chat
[*] Pedestrian System Added
[*] Added Manual Gear
[*] Added Selector Making
[*] Added Radio
[*] Added Special Horn to All Vehicles
[*] Added Long Road for Races
[*] Added Spoilers to Vehicle Customization Options
[*] Added Writing Behind Glass For All Vehicles
[*] Added Exit Button, Which We Have Forgotten, Much Wanted
[*] Added FPS Character
[*] Get on and Off System Added
[*] Character Added to Vehicle
[*] Improved Minimap
[*] Added Mansion (Character's Own House)
[*] Added Tuning Cars Sound Settings
[*] Added 17 New Language Options
[*] Increased the Number of Users from 10 to 30 in Online Mode
[*] Added EDS System
[*] Improved Lighting in Night Mode
[*] Added Cinematic Camera
[*] City Enlarged 3x and Town Added
[*] Signs and Environment Localized
[*] Added Airport
[*] Added Door Animation for All Vehicles
[*] Improved Smoke System While Drifting
[*] Added Rocket System (Rocket Battles are Waiting for You in Online Mode)
[*] Added Mission System
[*] Added Kasis
[/list]
and many more new features are waiting for you.
